steps: Log into your eCitizen account (NTSA portal).
Select the duration (1 year or 3 years).
Pay the required fee via M-Pesa.
Log into eCitizen and go to Department of Immigration Services.
Fill out the passport application form online.
Book an appointment for biometrics capture.
Attend the appointment with printed forms and original documents.

service: Police Clearance Certificate (Certificate of Good Conduct)
steps: Log into eCitizen and go to Directorate of Criminal Investigations.
Fill the Police Clearance application form.
Download and print 2 copies of the invoice and one copy of the C24 form.
Present yourself at DCI headquarters or select Huduma Centre for fingerprinting.
